reel.caption:
Does taking cash on a credit card really cost that much?

Card cash withdrawals get no interest-free period: interest runs from the day you take the cash until you repay in full.
Most cards also charge a cash withdrawal fee, typically 2.5% of the amount, with a minimum of a few hundred rupees.
Illustrative: ₹20,000 withdrawn → ₹500 fee + ₹600 interest at 3% for one month = about ₹1,100, before GST.
Monthly rates on cards typically run 2.5–3.5%, so check your own card's fee schedule.
